title: NullPointer in MessageDigest.java

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
Just updated to HEAD (been 5+ weeks).

I ran 'git bisect' and determined that this was broken by:
https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/6aff7f4f2bf0c6418fb88e967653f2feeb83819e

Is there some forced migration of WORKSPACE syntax?
This is a java repo with things like:

maven_jar(
    name = "guava-repo",
    artifact_id = "guava",
    group_id = "com.google.guava",
    sha1 = "cce0823396aa693798f8882e64213b1772032b09",
    version = "18.0",
)

bind(
    name = "guava",
    actual = "@guava-repo//jar",
)

and then uses of "//external:guava"

Unhandled exception thrown during build; message: Unrecoverable error while evaluating node 'REPOSITORY:@mockito-repo' (requested by nodes 'PACKAGE_LOOKUP:@mockito-repo//jar')
